versos.hebraico: הַֽלְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀ הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי־ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Praise Yahweh! Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
controles.kjv: Praise ye the Lord. O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
controles.livre: Aleluia! Agradecei ao SENHOR, porque ele é bom, porque sua bondade dura para sempre.

versos.hebraico: מִ֗י יְ֭מַלֵּל גְּבוּר֣וֹת יְהוָ֑ה יַ֝שְׁמִ֗יעַ כָּל־תְּהִלָּתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Who can utter the mighty acts of Yahweh, or fully declare all his praise?
controles.kjv: Who can utter the mighty acts of the Lord? who can shew forth all his praise?
controles.livre: Quem falará das proezas do SENHOR? Quem dirá louvores a ele?

versos.hebraico: אַ֭שְׁרֵי שֹׁמְרֵ֣י מִשְׁפָּ֑ט עֹשֵׂ֖ה צְדָקָ֣ה בְכָל־עֵֽת׃

controles.web: Blessed are those who keep justice. Blessed is one who does what is right at all times.
controles.kjv: Blessed are they that keep judgment, and he that doeth righteousness at all times.
controles.livre: Bem-aventurados são os que guardam o juízo; e aquele que pratica justiça em todo tempo.

versos.hebraico: זָכְרֵ֣נִי יְ֭הוָה בִּרְצ֣וֹן עַמֶּ֑ךָ פָּ֝קְדֵ֗נִי בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: Remember me, Yahweh, with the favor that you show to your people. Visit me with your salvation,
controles.kjv: Remember me, O Lord, with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people: O visit me with thy salvation;
controles.livre: Lembra-te de mim, SENHOR, conforme tua boa vontade para com teu povo; concede-me tua salvação.

versos.hebraico: לִרְא֤וֹת׀ בְּט֘וֹבַ֤ת בְּחִירֶ֗יךָ לִ֭שְׂמֹחַ בְּשִׂמְחַ֣ת גּוֹיֶ֑ךָ לְ֝הִתְהַלֵּ֗ל עִם־נַחֲלָתֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: that I may see the prosperity of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with your inheritance.
controles.kjv: That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.
controles.livre: Para eu ver o bem de teus escolhidos; para eu me alegrar com a alegria de teu povo; para eu ter orgulho de tua herança.

versos.hebraico: חָטָ֥אנוּ עִם־אֲבוֹתֵ֗ינוּ הֶעֱוִ֥ינוּ הִרְשָֽׁעְנוּ׃

controles.web: We have sinned with our fathers. We have committed iniquity. We have done wickedly.
controles.kjv: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.
controles.livre: Pecamos com nossos pais, fizemos o mal, agimos perversamente.

versos.hebraico: אֲב֘וֹתֵ֤ינוּ בְמִצְרַ֨יִם׀ לֹא־הִשְׂכִּ֬ילוּ נִפְלְאוֹתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א זָ֭כְרוּ אֶת־רֹ֣ב חֲסָדֶ֑יךָ וַיַּמְר֖וּ עַל־יָ֣ם בְּיַם־סֽוּף׃

controles.web: Our fathers didn’t understand your wonders in Egypt. They didn’t remember the multitude of your loving kindnesses, but were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.
controles.kjv: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies; but provoked him at the sea, even at the Red sea.
controles.livre: Nossos pais no Egito não deram atenção a tuas maravilhas, nem se lembraram da abundância de tuas bondades; mas ao invés disso se rebelaram junto ao mar, perto do mar Vermelho.

versos.hebraico: וַֽ֭יּוֹשִׁיעֵם לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמ֑וֹ לְ֝הוֹדִ֗יעַ אֶת־גְּבוּרָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power known.
controles.kjv: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.
controles.livre: Apesar disso ele os livrou por causa de seu nome, para que seu poder fosse conhecido.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּגְעַ֣ר בְּיַם־ס֭וּף וַֽיֶּחֱרָ֑ב וַיּוֹלִיכֵ֥ם בַּ֝תְּהֹמ֗וֹת כַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃

controles.web: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert.
controles.kjv: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.
controles.livre: E repreendeu ao mar Vermelho, e este se secou; e os fez caminharem pelas profundezas do mar ,como que pelo deserto.

versos.hebraico: וַֽ֭יּוֹשִׁיעֵם מִיַּ֣ד שׂוֹנֵ֑א וַ֝יִּגְאָלֵ֗ם מִיַּ֥ד אוֹיֵֽב׃

controles.web: He saved them from the hand of him who hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
controles.kjv: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
controles.livre: E os livrou das mãos daquele que os odiava, e os resgatou das mãos do inimigo.

versos.hebraico: וַיְכַסּוּ־מַ֥יִם צָרֵיהֶ֑ם אֶחָ֥ד מֵ֝הֶ֗ם לֹ֣א נוֹתָֽר׃

controles.web: The waters covered their adversaries. There was not one of them left.
controles.kjv: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.
controles.livre: E as águas cobriram seus adversários; não sobrou nem um sequer deles.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּאֲמִ֥ינוּ בִדְבָרָ֑יו יָ֝שִׁ֗ירוּ תְּהִלָּתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.
controles.kjv: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.
controles.livre: Então creram nas palavras dele, e cantaram louvores a ele.

versos.hebraico: מִֽ֭הֲרוּ שָׁכְח֣וּ מַעֲשָׂ֑יו לֹֽא־חִ֝כּ֗וּ לַעֲצָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: They soon forgot his works. They didn’t wait for his counsel,
controles.kjv: They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel:
controles.livre: Porém logo se esqueceram das obras dele, e não esperaram pelo seu conselho.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתְאַוּ֣וּ תַ֭אֲוָה בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַיְנַסּוּ־אֵ֝֗ל בִּֽישִׁימֽוֹן׃

controles.web: but gave in to craving in the desert, and tested God in the wasteland.
controles.kjv: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted God in the desert.
controles.livre: Mas foram levados pelo mau desejo no deserto, e tentaram a Deus no lugar desabitado.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭הֶם שֶׁאֱלָתָ֑ם וַיְשַׁלַּ֖ח רָז֣וֹן בְּנַפְשָֽׁם׃

controles.web: He gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.
controles.kjv: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.
controles.livre: Então ele lhes concedeu o que pediam, porém enviou magreza a suas almas.

versos.hebraico: וַיְקַנְא֣וּ לְ֭מֹשֶׁה בַּֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה לְ֝אַהֲרֹ֗ן קְד֣וֹשׁ יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron, Yahweh’s saint.
controles.kjv: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron the saint of the Lord.
controles.livre: E tiveram inveja de Moisés no acampamento; e de Arão, o santo do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: תִּפְתַּח־אֶ֭רֶץ וַתִּבְלַ֣ע דָּתָ֑ן וַ֝תְּכַ֗ס עַל־עֲדַ֥ת אֲבִירָֽם׃

controles.web: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.
controles.kjv: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.
controles.livre: A terra se abriu, e engoliu a Datã; e encobriu ao grupo de Abirão.

versos.hebraico: וַתִּבְעַר־אֵ֥שׁ בַּעֲדָתָ֑ם לֶ֝הָבָ֗ה תְּלַהֵ֥ט רְשָׁעִֽים׃

controles.web: A fire was kindled in their company. The flame burned up the wicked.
controles.kjv: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.
controles.livre: E o fogo consumiu o seu grupo; a chama queimou os perversos.

versos.hebraico: יַעֲשׂוּ־עֵ֥גֶל בְּחֹרֵ֑ב וַ֝יִּשְׁתַּחֲו֗וּ לְמַסֵּכָֽה׃

controles.web: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image.
controles.kjv: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.
controles.livre: Fizeram um bezerro em Horebe; e se inclinaram perante uma imagem de fundição.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּמִ֥ירוּ אֶת־כְּבוֹדָ֑ם בְּתַבְנִ֥ית שׁ֝֗וֹר אֹכֵ֥ל עֵֽשֶׂב׃

controles.web: Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass.
controles.kjv: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.
controles.livre: E mudaram sua glória na figura de um boi, que come erva.

versos.hebraico: שָׁ֭כְחוּ אֵ֣ל מוֹשִׁיעָ֑ם עֹשֶׂ֖ה גְדֹל֣וֹת בְּמִצְרָֽיִם׃

controles.web: They forgot God, their Savior, who had done great things in Egypt,
controles.kjv: They forgat God their saviour, which had done great things in Egypt;
controles.livre: Esqueceram-se de Deus, o salvador deles, que tinha feito coisas grandiosas no Egito,

versos.hebraico: נִ֭פְלָאוֹת בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חָ֑ם נ֝וֹרָא֗וֹת עַל־יַם־סֽוּף׃

controles.web: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome things by the Red Sea.
controles.kjv: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and terrible things by the Red sea.
controles.livre: Maravilhas na terra de Cam, coisas temíveis no mar Vermelho.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לְֽהַשְׁמִ֫ידָ֥ם לוּלֵ֡י מֹ֘שֶׁ֤ה בְחִיר֗וֹ עָמַ֣ד בַּפֶּ֣רֶץ לְפָנָ֑יו לְהָשִׁ֥יב חֲ֝מָת֗וֹ מֵֽהַשְׁחִֽית׃

controles.web: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had Moses, his chosen, not stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, so that he wouldn’t destroy them.
controles.kjv: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them.
controles.livre: Por isso ele disse que teria os destruído, se Moisés, seu escolhido, não tivesse se posto na fenda diante dele, para desviar sua ira, para não os destruir.

versos.hebraico: וַֽ֭יִּמְאֲסוּ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חֶמְדָּ֑ה לֹֽא־הֶ֝אֱמִ֗ינוּ לִדְבָרֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Yes, they despised the pleasant land. They didn’t believe his word,
controles.kjv: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word:
controles.livre: Eles também desprezaram a terra desejável, e não creram na palavra dele.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּרָגְנ֥וּ בְאָהֳלֵיהֶ֑ם לֹ֥א שָׁ֝מְע֗וּ בְּק֣וֹל יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: but murmured in their tents, and didn’t listen to Yahweh’s voice.
controles.kjv: But murmured in their tents, and hearkened not unto the voice of the Lord.
controles.livre: E ao invés disso murmuraram em suas tendas, e não deram ouvidos à voz do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשָּׂ֣א יָד֣וֹ לָהֶ֑ם לְהַפִּ֥יל א֝וֹתָ֗ם בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃

controles.web: Therefore he swore to them that he would overthrow them in the wilderness,
controles.kjv: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness:
controles.livre: Por isso ele levantou sua mão contra eles, jurando que os derrubaria no deserto;

versos.hebraico: וּלְהַפִּ֣יל זַ֭רְעָם בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם וּ֝לְזָרוֹתָ֗ם בָּאֲרָצֽוֹת׃

controles.web: that he would overthrow their seed among the nations, and scatter them in the lands.
controles.kjv: To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.
controles.livre: E que derrubaria sua semente entre as nações; e os dispersaria pelas terras.

versos.hebraico: וַ֭יִּצָּ֣מְדוּ לְבַ֣עַל פְּע֑וֹר וַ֝יֹּאכְל֗וּ זִבְחֵ֥י מֵתִֽים׃

controles.web: They joined themselves also to Baal Peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
controles.kjv: They joined themselves also unto Baal–peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
controles.livre: Eles também passaram a adorar Baal-Peor, e a comer sacrifícios dos mortos.

versos.hebraico: וַ֭יַּכְעִיסוּ בְּמַֽעַלְלֵיהֶ֑ם וַתִּפְרָץ־בָּ֝֗ם מַגֵּפָֽה׃

controles.web: Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds. The plague broke in on them.
controles.kjv: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions: and the plague brake in upon them.
controles.livre: E o provocaram à ira com as obras deles; e por isso surgiu a praga entre eles.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּעֲמֹ֣ד פִּֽ֭ינְחָס וַיְפַלֵּ֑ל וַ֝תֵּעָצַ֗ר הַמַּגֵּפָֽה׃

controles.web: Then Phinehas stood up, and executed judgment, so the plague was stopped.
controles.kjv: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and so the plague was stayed.
controles.livre: Então se levantou Fineias, e interveio, e cessou aquela praga.

versos.hebraico: וַתֵּחָ֣שֶׁב ל֭וֹ לִצְדָקָ֑ה לְדֹ֥ר וָ֝דֹ֗ר עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃

controles.web: That was credited to him for righteousness, for all generations to come.
controles.kjv: And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore.
controles.livre: E isto lhe foi reconhecido como justiça, de geração em geração, para todo o sempre.

versos.hebraico: וַ֭יַּקְצִיפוּ עַל־מֵ֥י מְרִיבָ֑ה וַיֵּ֥רַע לְ֝מֹשֶׁ֗ה בַּעֲבוּרָֽם׃

controles.web: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, so that Moses was troubled for their sakes;
controles.kjv: They angered him also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:
controles.livre: Também o irritaram muito junto às águas de Meribá; e houve mal a Moisés por causa deles;

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־הִמְר֥וּ אֶת־רוּח֑וֹ וַ֝יְבַטֵּ֗א בִּשְׂפָתָֽיו׃

controles.web: because they were rebellious against his spirit, he spoke rashly with his lips.
controles.kjv: Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.
controles.livre: Porque provocaram o seu espírito, de modo que ele falou imprudentemente com seus lábios.

versos.hebraico: לֹֽא־הִ֭שְׁמִידוּ אֶת־הָֽעַמִּ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה לָהֶֽם׃

controles.web: They didn’t destroy the peoples, as Yahweh commanded them,
controles.kjv: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom the Lord commanded them:
controles.livre: Eles não destruíram os povos que o SENHOR tinha lhes mandado;

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתְעָרְב֥וּ בַגּוֹיִ֑ם וַֽ֝יִּלְמְד֗וּ מַֽעֲשֵׂיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: but mixed themselves with the nations, and learned their works.
controles.kjv: But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.
controles.livre: Mas ao invés disso, se misturaram com as nações, e aprenderam as obras delas;

versos.hebraico: וַיַּעַבְד֥וּ אֶת־עֲצַבֵּיהֶ֑ם וַיִּהְי֖וּ לָהֶ֣ם לְמוֹקֵֽשׁ׃

controles.web: They served their idols, which became a snare to them.
controles.kjv: And they served their idols: which were a snare unto them.
controles.livre: E serviram a seus ídolos; e vieram a lhes ser por laço de armadilha.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּזְבְּח֣וּ אֶת־בְּ֭נֵיהֶם וְאֶת־בְּנֽוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם לַשֵּֽׁדִים׃

controles.web: Yes, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.
controles.kjv: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,
controles.livre: Além disso, sacrificaram seus filhos e suas filhas a demônios,

versos.hebraico: וַיִּֽשְׁפְּכ֨וּ דָ֪ם נָקִ֡י דַּם־בְּנֵ֘יהֶ֤ם וּֽבְנוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר זִ֭בְּחוּ לַעֲצַבֵּ֣י כְנָ֑עַן וַתֶּחֱנַ֥ף הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ בַּדָּמִֽים׃

controles.web: They shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan. The land was polluted with blood.
controles.kjv: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.
controles.livre: E derramaram sangue inocente, o sangue de seus filhos e de suas filhas, os quais eles sacrificaram aos ídolos de Canaã; e a terra foi profanada com este sangue.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּטְמְא֥וּ בְמַעֲשֵׂיהֶ֑ם וַ֝יִּזְנוּ֗ בְּמַֽעַלְלֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: Thus were they defiled with their works, and prostituted themselves in their deeds.
controles.kjv: Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.
controles.livre: E contaminaram-se com suas obras; e se prostituíram com suas ações.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּֽחַר־אַ֣ף יְהוָ֣ה בְּעַמּ֑וֹ וַ֝יְתָעֵ֗ב אֶת־נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Therefore Yahweh burned with anger against his people. He abhorred his inheritance.
controles.kjv: Therefore was the wrath of the Lord kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.
controles.livre: Por isso a ira do SENHOR se acendeu contra seu povo; e ele odiou sua propriedade.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתְּנֵ֥ם בְּיַד־גּוֹיִ֑ם וַֽיִּמְשְׁל֥וּ בָ֝הֶ֗ם שֹׂנְאֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: He gave them into the hand of the nations. Those who hated them ruled over them.
controles.kjv: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.
controles.livre: E os entregou nas mãos das nações estrangeiras, e aqueles que os odiavam passaram a dominá-los.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּלְחָצ֥וּם אוֹיְבֵיהֶ֑ם וַ֝יִּכָּנְע֗וּ תַּ֣חַת יָדָֽם׃

controles.web: Their enemies also oppressed them. They were brought into subjection under their hand.
controles.kjv: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.
controles.livre: E seus inimigos os oprimiram, e foram humilhados sob as mãos deles.

versos.hebraico: פְּעָמִ֥ים רַבּ֗וֹת יַצִּ֫ילֵ֥ם וְ֭הֵמָּה יַמְר֣וּ בַעֲצָתָ֑ם וַ֝יָּמֹ֗כּוּ בַּעֲוֺנָֽם׃

controles.web: Many times he delivered them, but they were rebellious in their counsel, and were brought low in their iniquity.
controles.kjv: Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked him with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity.
controles.livre: Muitas vezes ele os livrou; mas eles voltavam a irritá-lo com seus pensamentos, e foram abatidos pela sua perversidade.

versos.hebraico: וַ֭יַּרְא בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם בְּ֝שָׁמְע֗וֹ אֶת־רִנָּתָֽם׃

controles.web: Nevertheless he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry.
controles.kjv: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:
controles.livre: Apesar disso, ele observou a angústia deles, e ouviu quando eles clamaram.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּזְכֹּ֣ר לָהֶ֣ם בְּרִית֑וֹ וַ֝יִּנָּחֵ֗ם כְּרֹ֣ב חסדו׃

controles.web: He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
controles.kjv: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.
controles.livre: E ele se lembrou de seu pacto em favor deles, e sentiu pena conforme suas muitas bondades.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן אוֹתָ֣ם לְרַחֲמִ֑ים לִ֝פְנֵ֗י כָּל־שׁוֹבֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: He made them also to be pitied by all those who carried them captive.
controles.kjv: He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives.
controles.livre: E fez com que todos os que os mantinham em cativeiro tivessem misericórdia deles.

versos.hebraico: הוֹשִׁיעֵ֨נוּ׀ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְקַבְּצֵנוּ֮ מִֽן־הַגּ֫וֹיִ֥ם לְ֭הֹדוֹת לְשֵׁ֣ם קָדְשֶׁ֑ךָ לְ֝הִשְׁתַּבֵּ֗חַ בִּתְהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: Save us, Yahweh, our God, gather us from among the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise!
controles.kjv: Save us, O Lord our God, and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks unto thy holy name, and to triumph in thy praise.
controles.livre: Salva-nos, SENHOR nosso Deus, e ajunta-nos dentre as nações, para darmos graças ao teu santo nome, e termos orgulho em louvar a ti.

versos.hebraico: בָּר֤וּךְ־יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵ֪י יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל מִן־הָ֤עוֹלָ֨ם׀ וְעַ֬ד הָעוֹלָ֗ם וְאָמַ֖ר כָּל־הָעָ֥ם אָמֵ֗ן הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃

controles.web: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting! Let all the people say, “Amen.” Praise Yah!
controles.kjv: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye the Lord.
controles.livre: Bendito seja o SENHOR, Deus de Israel, desde sempre e para sempre! E todo o povo diga Amém! Aleluia!
